basic_info.description: Experience the epitome of San Francisco penthouse living on Vallejo Street in Pacific Heights! This luxurious two-bedroom, one and a half-bath condo perfectly embodies the essence of indoor/outdoor living, showcasing breathtaking views of the iconic Golden Gate Bridge, the Bay and Palace of Fine Arts. The wall to wall living room windows offer beautiful Bridge and Bay views. A few steps to the left lead out to the large private deck, which is an entertainer's dream! The kitchen, featuring original appliances and counter, provides a charming retro touch. This distinctive home includes parking and extra storage. Building amenities include a laundry room, community room, exercise room, and communal viewing deck. Access to the apartment is via a secure entry and an elevator. With only 3 apartments on the very top floor, this penthouse also offers exclusivity.  Situated just a stone's throw away from vibrant Union, Fillmore and Chestnut Streets, 2295 Vallejo, PH-1 offers unparalleled access to some of the City's most sought-after shops, eateries, and boutiques. Whether you enjoy indulging in gourmet dining or exploring unique stores, everything you desire is within easy reach. Though once you're home, you may never want to leave.
